summary: The complete legal domain contains only one through ten decimal digits, which is too narrow for a reliable scaling trend; direct digit processing establishes the required bound.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source constraint 1 <= n <= 10^9 limits every legal input to at most ten decimal digits.

replacement_checks.evidence: Each loop removes one decimal digit with integer division by ten, so at most ten iterations occur on any legal input.
Authored cases cover one and ten digits, the maximum value, trailing and internal zeros, both subtraction directions, and palindromes.
